verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs describe it as generating a full TypeScript/React frontend plus backend endpoints, database, and schema from a single natural-language description (floot-docs-33, floot-docs-26, floot-probe-1), and the AI-assistant toolset covers backend logic like query_database/execute_sql alongside UI generation (floot-docs-4). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer verification of a single-prompt full-stack generation and more detail on how frontend/backend are coordinated in one step.
